extraction.features: canonical signed input weights folded by readout sign and normalized within hidden columns; profiles across source tasks
extraction.targets: individual canonical IMP masks with nonzero edge classes assigned by inferred cross-task prototypes

vae.checkpoint: minimum inferred-index validation cross-entropy; no analytic indexator

rules: Pattern is the original 11-bit input and 4-bit substring task; a hidden unit corresponds to one possible window.
Source networks are ordinary independently weighted 11-8-1 MLPs, trained and magnitude-pruned with rewinding.
Index extraction uses only training-network weights/masks and source query quality; no analytic index labels.
NF encoders are separate per source task; the categorical index decoder is shared.
Codebook C[0]=0 is fixed; four other values, shared hidden bias, shared readout and output bias are trained on each task.
VAE is frozen during task solving; vae_z trains only z and the seven numeric task parameters.
No independent per-edge weights are trained in codebook methods. Dense Adam is an explicitly separate baseline.
Numeric hyperparameters are selected on source patterns only; target labels are opened after extraction, VAE fitting and tuning.
All final methods have 32 starts and 4096 gradient steps per target; compare against analytic indices without training on them.
Report held-out 512-input metrics and exact uniform-input metrics over all 2048 bit strings.
Pattern shares a common indexator across tasks: success need not demonstrate a benefit from optimizing z.
Align good masks to a reference learned from training solutions with Hungarian column assignments. Analytic masks are never alignment references.
Refine the consensus and choose its initialization by training-mask agreement. Infer tying by cross-source weight profiles after this alignment.
The bank retains the best quarter by source-query BCE separately for every task and seed split, excluding BCE >=0.5. Near-perfect classification is not required.
Collection is reused from v2; only source quality filtering, alignment and extraction change.
Nonzero labels on the inferred consensus support preserve the balanced clustering assignment, instead of reassigning them by an unconstrained nearest-centroid rule.
Presence probabilities sum the four nonzero classes before top-32 selection; no new cardinality constraints are introduced.
